text:
marie: Heads-up — we have a planned deploy freeze tomorrow 09:00-13:00 UTC. Can folks who need merges for this sprint surface PRs they want merged before freeze? I'm also trying to reserve a rebase window for infra changes. Please ping if CI is flaky.

aditya: +1 — I have two small fixes in https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/2145 and https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/2146. Both need one more OK. CI has been passing locally.

leo: FYI my large model-router change depends on infra PR 789, can't merge until that is in. Rebase window would help. Link: <https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/789>

sre-bot: deploy-freeze scheduled by @marie for 2026-03-18 09:00 UTC — reminders will go out 1h before :bell:

marie: @leo what's the ETA on infra PR 789? Any known flaky tests?

leo: ETA EOD today if no surprises. CI failing intermittently in gpu-smoke tests; looks like flakiness on the runner. Stack:
```
Error: timeout waiting for container
...GPU init logs...
```
I filed https://github.com/redwood/infra/issues/1032

dina: Can we carve a 30m rebase slot at 08:00 UTC tomorrow? That avoids the freeze and gives us time to validate. @sre-bot can you hold capacity?

sre-bot: reserving rebase slot 2026-03-18 08:00-08:30 UTC for eng-releases — assigned to team=eng-runtime — capacity hold applied.

kyle: I can review aditya's PRs this afternoon. @aditya leave a note when ready for final review.

aditya: Thanks @kyle — will update tests & mark ready by 16:00 UTC.

qa-bot: CI history for infra PR 789: last 5 runs = [pass, flaky, pass, fail, pass]. Recommend re-run after runner redeploy. Triggered redeploy job link: <https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/12222>

marie: ok plan: @leo finish infra PR 789 today; @aditya finish tests by 16:00; rebase slot 08:00-08:30 tomorrow; I'll coordinate merges at 08:40. If CI still flaky we'll fallback to canary-only rollout. :white_check_mark:

leo: sounds good, will ping when infra PR is green.

aditya: ping @kyle — ready for review: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/2145 (small change), https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/2146 (test updates).

kyle: reviewing now, expect done by 17:30 UTC.

marie: thanks all — tagging this thread for follow-up. :spiral_calendar:
